security_audit.summary: The reviewed matches are documentation and example code for the CoinGecko API, not executable skill behavior. API keys are placeholders or named environment variables, endpoint URLs target CoinGecko, and apparent traversal or shell patterns occur in rendered documentation. One low-severity metadata issue is confirmed: SKILL.md has text before its YAML front matter. Static review was capped at 400/625 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 225 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Invalid YAML front matter in SKILL.md
remediation.suggestion: Move the translated-content marker below the closing front matter delimiter, or remove it, so the file starts with the YAML delimiter.
